name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: key_lost is defined as the key being lost (dropped) while door_open is false, so Absence(key_lost) exactly expresses 'don't drop the key while the door is still closed' — the event's own description already carries the 'still closed' condition, so a plain Absence is right and no Precedence(door_open, key_lost) is needed. The task commands nothing unconditionally (pure prohibition), so the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES and the rejecting state u1 on key_lost with a hard penalty are all valid, and the hard priority matches the categorical 'Don't' with no preference cue.

texts: The key is never dropped while the door is still closed.

REJECTING_STATES: u1
